criteria.criterion: Use only the supplied NASA/JPL SBDB response (99942 Apophis, phys-par=1)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not fabricate any values and explicitly refused to extract fields it claimed were not visible. This satisfies the 'use only supplied response' constraint in the sense of not using outside info, but the agent’s claim that the response was truncated is contradicted by screenshots showing the required fields are in fact present in the supplied response view. Still, criterion 0 is primarily about source integrity (no external/hallucinated data), which the agent maintained.

The agent output did not report object.fullname at all, and incorrectly claimed it could not be accessed despite it being visible in the supplied response (Screenshot 1). This is a controllable failure/omission, not an uncontrollable blocker.
